front: When did the world reach 8 billion people?
back: November 2022 (United Nations). 7 billion was reached in 2011.

Malthus (1798): population outgrows food, so famine, disease and war act as checks. Boserup (1965): population pressure stimulates innovation and higher food output.

front: Why can a dense country be rich?
back: Density is not overpopulation: trade, technology and skills can support high living standards.
